title: Skill Frontmatter
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter block of shared/skills/*/SKILL.md files. Source of truth: shared/contracts/skill-frontmatter-contract.md.

name.description: kebab-case identifier; must match the parent directory name (shared/skills/adr/SKILL.md -> name: adr).

description.description: One sentence. What the skill does and when Claude should auto-trigger it.

triggers.description: Auto-trigger routing table. Both sub-keys must be present; an empty list is acceptable for manual-invocation-only skills, but the key itself must exist.

keywords.description: Literal string matches; routing fires when any keyword appears in user input.

intentPatterns.description: Fuzzy sentence patterns with * wildcards for user-supplied nouns.

standalone.description: Must be true. Skills that require MCP servers or external network calls to function are not portable across installs — enforces the 'everything must work offline' discipline.

status.description: Lifecycle status. Absent means active. Set to 'deprecated' when the skill is superseded and kept only for backward compatibility. Pair with superseded_by.

superseded_by.description: kebab-case name of the agent or skill that replaces this one. Required when status is 'deprecated'. health-check.sh will FAIL if the referenced name does not exist.
